origin.name: AppleIntelHD4000GraphicsMTLDriver
origin.note: OCLP's HD 4000 Metal driver (PatcherSupportPkg 2.0.5, hardware overlay)

edits.reason: the driver loads the Metal selector shim, so frameworks that send newer Metal selectors get an answer instead of an unrecognized-selector crash; weak, so the driver still loads without the library
